head.index.title: Lecturameter · Reading Tracker & Book Stats
head.index.description: Track your reading time, pages, pace and progress with a private Android reading tracker. No account, no ads. Import from Goodreads and StoryGraph.
head.index.ld_description: Organize your library, time reading sessions and view detailed stats on your Android phone. No ads, fully private.
head.index.ld_featurelist: Library with shelves, timer with screen off, session history, heatmap, yearly wrapped, customizable reading challenges, Google Drive backup, Goodreads CSV import, mostly offline
head.index.faq1_q: Can I bring my library from other apps?
head.index.faq1_a: Yes. Go to Settings > Import/Export and follow the step-by-step wizard. Supported apps: Goodreads (CSV): export from goodreads.com > My Books > Import and export > Export Library. StoryGraph (CSV): export from app.thestorygraph.com > Manage account > Import/Export > Export STG Library (CSV arrives by email). Bookmory (.bookmory or XLSX): Settings > Backup > Export. Fable / ShelfBridge (CSV): export via the ShelfBridge extension. Book Tracker (CSV): Settings > Export. Lecturameter CSV: exported from another device running Lecturameter. Other apps (Babelio, Pagebound, Bookshelf, Delibrista…): any CSV compatible with the Goodreads/StoryGraph format.
head.index.faq2_a: Absolutely. Your data is stored only on your phone. Your library never leaves your device. The app sends anonymous usage statistics and crash reports, which you can turn off in Settings. Also, if a search finds nothing, that text or ISBN is kept, with no identifier, so the missing works can be added. If you enable Google Drive backup, only you have access to those files.
head.index.faq3_a: No. The app is free with an optional one-time Pro purchase.
head.index.faq4_a: Almost everything works offline. You only need a connection to search for new books and to upload Google Drive backups.
head.index.faq5_a: Yes, in public beta: you can try it now with TestFlight. If it won't install yet, check back in a while.
head.index.faq6_a: Yes. There's a free 7-day trial of Pro features, no card required. On iPhone it is a free App Store in-app purchase, tied to your Apple ID. On Android, at the end of the trial, even if you don't buy Pro, you get a free Pro theme of your choice.
head.index.faq7_q: What happens to my Pro if I change phone?
head.index.faq7_a: It depends on where you bought it. If you bought it on Google Play and you switch to another Android with the same Google account, install Lecturameter and tap Restore purchase in Settings. If you bought it on the App Store and you switch to another iPhone with the same Apple ID, same thing: install and tap Restore purchase. To move between Android and iPhone in either direction, use a transfer code: on your current phone, in Lecturameter Settings, Pair device, get a temporary code, enter it on the new device and it activates there too. lm-... codes can only be redeemed on Android. If you sell or lose the old device, you can revoke it from the same screen.
head.index.faq8_q: Can I move my Pro between phones and between iOS and Android?
head.index.faq8_a: Yes, between Android and iPhone, in either direction. You do it with a transfer code generated inside the app, in Settings. Between two phones on the same platform you do not need it: use Restore purchase with your Google account or Apple ID.

release.3_7.new: Lecturameter comes to iPhone in beta, through TestFlight
Comics, manga and audiobooks as first-class items: add them in one manual form or several at once, and share your audiobook card
Bring your library from another app (Goodreads, StoryGraph, Bookmory, Fable) with a preview
Series view: your books grouped by series, filled in automatically when you add them
Monthly recap with a shareable card, plus "Your book of each month" in Wrapped
My cards: every card you've shared, in one place
Add several books at once from search
Credits per edition: narrators, translators and illustrators
Pro works on up to 3 devices, Android and iOS
Backups now also save your tags and reminders
You can now save a reading session without pages, just the time (handy if you read digitally)

Texts now name the type: book, comic, manga or audiobook
The star row no longer rates while you scroll
Long notes are shown in full
Dates and backup errors in the app language
Restoring from Drive no longer picks the wrong file
Prevented a crash when tapping an author link in some situations
Prevented an unexpected close of the timer in the background
Prevented unexpected closes when buying Pro and in some widgets
Fixed a confusing number in comic and manga search results
release.3_8.headline: Progress in %, Pagi outfits and skins, KOSync, right-to-left languages
release.3_8.new: Progress in %: log your sessions as a percentage in books, comics, manga and audiobooks. In audiobooks you can also note the time.
Change the format of a book, comic, manga or audiobook after adding it, without losing sessions, notes or stats.
Several notes and quotes when you finish a session, each one separate.
If you leave a session without saving, it is kept as a draft and you can recover it the next time you save one.
Stats: donut with what you read by format and a format filter to see each type separately.
Audiobook challenges (hours listened and audiobooks finished) and Bingo with audiobooks: 1 hour of listening counts as 30 pages.

Pagi debuts 7 animated seasonal outfits that work with any theme, 9 new skins (Bard, Night Thief, Vampire Count, Submarine Captain, Ink, Origami, Night Reader, Knight-errant and Retro Astronaut) and its own tap animation with each one. There is also a secret skin hidden in the app: tap around the main screen to find it.
Pagi has its own section in Settings: automatic season, seasonal outfits out of season, and skins.

App icons for Pro: pick yours in Settings, with Halloween, Christmas and New Year versions. If you turn on automatic seasonal change, the icon changes on its dates and then goes back to yours. It is off by default.
If you tried Pro, you also get one of the Pro icons as a gift.
Sync your progress with your e-reader through KOSync (KOReader and compatible ones), with a step by step wizard.
The app is now in Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu, with a right-to-left interface. You can also pick them as the book language when adding one by hand.
New Pro timer sounds, with a new category, Cozy.
release.3_8.fixes: Better genre selection for every kind of book.
Some stats colors changed to tell each data point apart better.
If an e-reader book has no title, a readable name is shown instead of a code, and the wizard warns you if no progress arrives with your user.
Bingo is now translated in every language.
All languages reviewed: texts that showed up in English or Spanish now appear in your language.
Backups saved on your phone no longer end up empty if saving fails.
Changing a book's status no longer erases the dates of earlier reads.
The monthly recap also counts finished books with no sessions.
release.3_9.headline: Events, a renewed Home and new book cards
release.3_9.new: Global challenge: The Great Read. 14 days reading together. Timer minutes count, with a shared goal and a live leaderboard.
Lecturameter Quest: The Forgotten Library. Pick 3 books, choose your path on the map and beat the boss. 5 levels and a points leaderboard.
Also: Event card, Pagi as your avatar, event alerts.
Android and iPhone: the same event on both.

Renewed UI in home: the rail icons are grouped into 3 floating menus: Goals (Events, Challenges, Bingos), My reading (Statistics, My cards, Wrapped) and Tools (Reminders, Tags, ISBN scanner). Reorder them with a long press. Counters per group, the rail folds away as you scroll, and in Dusk the icons alternate orange and blue.

Renewed book cards: no trash can or loose stars (now a ★ 4.5 chip), Material icons instead of emojis and tags at the bottom. In Abandoned you see the page where you left off ("You stopped at page X of Y"); in Finished, the date you finished it.
New tips, no tutorial: the tutorial is gone and everything is explained with tips, plus a battery notice the first time you use the timer. Landscape improvements for tablets and iPhone Duo.
Books without a page count (e.g. from KOReader): the app asks you for the total pages.
Bingo: 12 new 4x4 templates and 12 new 3x3 templates, horror theme in November and romance in February.
KOSync: improvements so you don't depend on the app's timer: KOSync sends the reading time.
Random picker in Want to read: Pagi decides for you.

legal.privacy.tagline_001: Your reading data is yours. Period.
legal.privacy.ddesc_004: Lecturameter has no server of its own for your library. Your books, sessions, and statistics live only on your phone and in your own backups. No ads, no tracking, no user accounts, and we never sell your data or use it for advertising.
legal.privacy.p_007: This page mirrors the privacy policy you see inside the app. It explains, in plain language, what data Lecturameter keeps and what leaves your device.
legal.privacy.p_009: Your books, reading sessions, statistics, challenges, and bingo are stored only on your device (the app is offline-first). If you turn on backups, they are saved wherever you choose:
legal.privacy.li_010: Android: a local file on your own device, or your Google Drive. For Drive, the app can only see and touch the files it created there itself (the drive.file scope), never the rest of your Drive.
legal.privacy.li_011: iOS: a local file in the app's folder (accessible from the Files app), or your iCloud. The iCloud backup uses only the app's own container in your iCloud; Apple handles encryption and sync. You can also back up to your Google Drive: the app only sees the files it created there, nothing else from your account.
legal.privacy.p_012: No one but you can see those files.
legal.privacy.p_013: 2. No third-party analytics, no ads, no accounts
legal.privacy.li_014: We use no third-party analytics SDKs and no advertising or cross-app tracking tools.
legal.privacy.li_016: You don't need to create any account to use the app.
legal.privacy.li_017: We never sell your data or use it for advertising or profiling.
legal.privacy.li_018: We do collect our own optional pseudonymous usage statistics and crash reports, both described in section 3. You can turn them off in Settings > Help and about > Privacy.
legal.privacy.p_019: 3. Pseudonymous usage statistics and crash reports
legal.privacy.p_020: Pseudonymous usage statistics (optional): the app sends to Lecturameter's own server (hosted on Cloudflare) a random installation identifier generated by the app itself, which changes every 90 days and is not linked to your identity, the device advertising ID or any account; the app version, the platform and names of product events (for example: first book added, trial started or ended, share card used), plus whether you come back to the app on day 1, 7 and 30. Nothing from your library, no book titles and no personal data are sent. This data is not used for advertising, cross-app tracking, or profiling, and is never sold to third parties.
legal.privacy.p_021: Crash reports (optional): if the app closes unexpectedly or, on Android, stops responding, it sends a technical report to the Lecturameter server: the error type and message, the trace of the app's code (for an Android hang, only the main thread's), the app version, the device model and manufacturer, the system version and the language. It does not include your library, your notes or any identifier. The error message is technical, but in rare cases it may include a fragment of the data that caused it. You can turn it off in Settings > Help and about > Privacy > Crash reports.
legal.privacy.p_022: Both options can be turned off in Settings > Help and about > Privacy (the “Usage statistics” and “Crash reports” switches).
legal.privacy.p_024: When you search for a book or scan an ISBN, that text or code goes to Lecturameter's catalog server (hosted on Cloudflare), which queries public book catalogs for you (Google Books, Open Library, Wikidata, AniList, MangaUpdates, Kitsu) to bring back the title, cover or author. Our server does not store your IP address, and the results are kept in a temporary cache (from a few hours to 30 days) that is not linked to anyone. No personal data of yours is sent in these queries.
legal.privacy.p_025: Lecturameter also installs a local book catalog on your device: a database of its own with about 12,000 works that downloads with the app. It is what lets you search for books offline. That catalog is app content, holds no data of yours, and neither what you search in it nor what you find ever leaves your device.
legal.privacy.p_026: If the Lecturameter catalog finds nothing for your search, or you add a book that was not in it, our server saves what you searched for (the text, up to 200 characters, or the ISBN), the type of search, the identifiers of the book you add, the date and a hash of the app's user agent, so we know which works are missing and can add them. It does not save your IP address or any identifier of you or your device, and it keeps this for 90 days at most. This helps every user improve the catalog, so it has no switch in Settings. You can read where that catalog comes from in this section of the website.
legal.privacy.p_028: Sending feedback or answering a survey inside the app is entirely optional. If you choose to, the text you wrote is sent along with technical device information (model, OS version (Android or iOS), and app version) to Lecturameter's developer, so they can read it and improve the app. If you also choose to attach app logs or screenshots, those are sent too; both are optional and only included if you add them.
legal.privacy.p_029: 6. Lecturameter Pro and code redemption
legal.privacy.p_030: Lecturameter Pro payments are handled by Google Play (on Android) or the Apple App Store (on iOS): the app never sees or stores your payment details. On iOS there are also optional tips (consumable in-app purchases) that unlock nothing. When you make or restore a purchase, the store's purchase identifier is sent to Lecturameter's license server only to validate the purchase. If you redeem a promo code, that code and a device identifier are sent to Lecturameter's redemption server, only to validate the code and limit how many devices can use it.
legal.privacy.p_032: To prevent abuse of the free trial and to verify your Pro license, the app sends a device identifier to Lecturameter's license server (hosted on Cloudflare): the Android ID on Android, the vendor identifier on iOS. It is sent when you start the free trial, when you redeem or restore Pro with a code, when you restore purchases, and when the app retries a pending trial registration at startup. It is not used for advertising or profiling and is not linked to your name.
legal.privacy.p_034: It is optional: if you don't connect an e-reader, nothing is sent. If you connect one (KOReader, CrossPoint or any other KOSync-compatible one), the app sends to Lecturameter's sync server (hosted on Cloudflare, in Western Europe) a sync username (3 to 32 characters, with no email or personal data; it is not a Lecturameter account) and the key your e-reader uses, which the server stores only as a salted hash. For each synced book it stores the document identifier, position, percentage, device name and id, date and, if your e-reader sends them, the title, authors and file name. We don't store your IP address: request limits are counted on the fly by Cloudflare.
legal.privacy.p_035: How to delete it: when you disconnect the e-reader, check "Also delete my data from the server". The user and all its progress are removed from the server. If you disconnect without checking it, the data stays on the server. If you no longer have the app or the e-reader, write to lecturameter.app@gmail.com with your sync username and we will delete the user and all its progress from the server within 30 days at most.
legal.privacy.li_038: Internet: to search for books, back up to Drive, send feedback, redeem codes, start the free trial, and send pseudonymous statistics and crash reports (when enabled).
legal.privacy.li_039: Local storage and images: to save and read your backups and book covers on the device.
legal.privacy.li_040: Camera: to scan a book's barcode (ISBN) and, if you want, to take photos of your copy's spine and edges. Those photos are stored only on your device and in your backups (if enabled), and are never sent anywhere else.
legal.privacy.li_041: Notifications: for the active reading session timer and to alert you about your weekly recap and when your Wrapped is ready.
legal.privacy.li_042: Do Not Disturb access, only if you turn on automatic Do Not Disturb in immersive reading mode: you grant it in the system settings and can revoke it at any time. The reading timer runs as a foreground service with a persistent notification, so the elapsed time stays accurate while the app is in the background.
legal.privacy.li_043: Google account (OAuth2, optional): only if you enable Drive backup. You can revoke access at any time from your Google account.
legal.privacy.li_045: Camera: to scan a book's barcode (ISBN) and, if you want, to take photos of your copy's spine and edges. Those photos are stored only on your device and in your backups (if enabled), and are never sent anywhere else.
legal.privacy.li_046: Photos: only for the image you choose as a book cover; the app does not access the rest of your photo library.
legal.privacy.li_047: Notifications: for the active reading session timer, Live Activity, and reading reminders.
legal.privacy.li_048: iCloud (optional): only if you enable iCloud backup. You can turn it off at any time from the iCloud settings on your device.
legal.privacy.li_049: Google account access, only if you turn on Google Drive backup; you can revoke it at any time from your Google account.
legal.privacy.p_051: On Android: Google Play Billing processes the payments for Pro; the app never sees your payment data. Google Drive stores your optional backups in your own Google account, and the app only sees the files it created. The barcode scanner (Google ML Kit) and the document scanner (Google Play services) process images on your device; Google may receive usage and performance metrics and per-installation identifiers from these components, under Google's own privacy policy. Public book catalogs receive your searches through our server, as described above. Cloudflare hosts Lecturameter's servers. We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.
legal.privacy.p_052: On iOS: The App Store processes the payments for Pro and tips; the app never sees your payment data. Google Drive can store your optional backups in your own Google account, and the app only sees the files it created. Public book catalogs receive your searches through our server, as described above. Cloudflare hosts Lecturameter's servers. We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.
legal.privacy.p_054: If you have any privacy questions, write to lecturameter.app@gmail.com.
legal.privacy.p_056: If this policy changes, we will update this same page with the new date at the top.
legal.privacy.li_058: drive.file scope in the Google Drive API documentation.
legal.privacy.li_059: Payments handled by Google Play and the Apple App Store: the app never sees your payment details.

legal.privacy1999.p_010: 2. No third-party analytics or advertising

legal.privacy1999.p_014: 3. Anonymous usage statistics and crash reports (optional)
legal.privacy1999.p_015: Anonymous usage statistics (optional, on by default): the app sends to Lecturameter's own server (hosted on Cloudflare) a random installation identifier generated by the app itself, not tied to you, the device advertising ID, or any account, along with the app version, platform and names of product events (for example: first book added, first session, import finished), plus day-1, day-7, and day-30 return flags. legal.privacy1999.p_016: Crash reports (optional, on by default): if the app crashes or freezes, it sends to Lecturameter's own server the app version, OS version, device manufacturer and model, language and the technical error details, only to fix the bug.

legal.privacy1999.p_021: Lecturameter 1999 has optional one-time (non-consumable) purchases that unlock cosmetic extras: the themes pack (with its backgrounds, sounds and screensavers), screensavers, Pagi costumes and a bundle with everything. The app only receives the purchase confirmation to activate what you bought and never sees or stores your payment details.
legal.privacy1999.li_023: Internet: for book search, anonymous statistics and crash reports (when enabled), and purchases.
legal.privacy1999.li_024: Network state (Android): to know whether there is a connection before searching or sending data.
legal.privacy1999.li_025: Google Play billing (Android): for purchases and tips.
legal.privacy1999.li_026: It does not ask for notifications, camera, location or contacts. Backups, CSV files and gallery covers are picked with the system picker, which needs no permissions.
legal.privacy1999.p_028: If you have any privacy questions, write to lecturameter.app@gmail.com.
